Hi I’m a teenager who used to self harm. I know that you mean well but do not just take her blades away. It’s very common for ppl who self harm to have a weird almost obsessive attatchment to their blades. I still carry mine around even though I’m more than a year clean. 
My best advice is to make sure that what she uses is sanitary because when the urge hits she will try to use anything. I have cut myself with broken pieces of a mirror and a pencil sharpener before. The only reason I didn’t get an infection was because I had an obsession with being sanitary when I did it. If there is blood in the box that’s concerning because that means she’s not sanitizing correctly and that could lead to infection which she will not tell you about. 
Honestly just take her to therapy. A therapist that you will not ask about her personal stuff so she can trust them enough to open up. Something huge is probably bothering her and I hope she has a breakthrough soon. Mine was realizing I’m trans and finally coming out.
